themes.name: School Learning Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve K–12 education through academic support, school facilities, teacher retention, class conditions, or student meals belong here.

themes.name: Housing Affordability and Supply
themes.rule: Proposals that make housing more affordable, improve existing homes, increase residential supply, or provide student housing belong here.

themes.name: Waste Reduction and Recycling
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce discarded materials through composting, recycling collection, or restrictions on disposable products belong here.

themes.name: Arts and Cultural Access
themes.rule: Proposals that provide public art, cultural events, museum access, or arts instruction belong here.

themes.name: Digital City Access
themes.rule: Proposals that improve access to city information or services through online tools, service channels, public connectivity, or digital assistance belong here.

themes.name: Small Business and Workforce Opportunity
themes.rule: Proposals that support businesses, independent workers, job seekers, or local hiring through finance, workspace, licensing, training, or contracting belong here.

themes.name: Transit and Active Travel
themes.rule: Proposals that improve public-transit service or make cycling and other everyday travel alternatives to driving more practical belong here.

themes.name: Parks, Trees and Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals that create or upgrade parks, playgrounds, community gardens, street trees, or neighborhood recreation spaces belong here.

themes.name: Health and Care Services
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical care, mental-health support, preventive screening, or in-home support for residents belong here.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent or respond to physical harm through emergency services, policing, surveillance, street lighting, or traffic calming belong here.

themes.name: Clean Air and Municipal Energy
themes.rule: Proposals that monitor air pollution or reduce municipal energy emissions through clean-energy infrastructure belong here.
